data.name: Victory Acres
data.detailed_description:
Victory Acres is a wartime farming strategy game where every harvest helps defend your island.

Plow fields, sow crops, irrigate, harvest, fulfill contracts, and deliver vital supplies across a retro island inhabited by animal townsfolk. Grow your farm while balancing your own success against the increasing demands of the war effort.

Stock up supplies, stop by the bank for loans or war bonds, unwind with some drinks at Clara's Pub, and help supply a community counting on every shipment.

Farm With Purpose

Plow, plant, irrigate, harvest, and deliver crops. As your operation expands, so does your responsibility

Defend the Island

Earn War Bonds and build anti-aircraft guns, radar stations, and other military defenses to protect the island from increasingly dangerous air raids. The military must produce better and better equipment to adapt to advancing enemy technology.

Expand Your Farm

Unlock irrigation, greenhouses, orchards, new machinery, larger storage, and better vehicles as your farm grows.

Deliver What Matters

Complete contracts, supply local businesses, and earn the money needed to keep both your farm and the island moving forward.

Support the City

Visit local shops, the bank, cafés, and Clara's Pub while getting to know the island's animal residents who rely on your harvests and reward you for special requests.

The Home Front

As the island preparing for war, quiet mornings in the fields can give way to air raid sirens by night. Life is peaceful—but not for long. As the war draws closer, your farm becomes an essential part of the island's survival.

Will Your Farm Be Enough?

Every harvest you deliver and every war bond you spend helps determine the island's future.

Grow, build, and defend your way to victory!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel Core i3-7100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5500 / Intel Core i5 2400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Catalina (10.15) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th Gen or newer) OR Apple M1 chip
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 555X (or equivalent)
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Monterey 12+
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 / M3 chip or Intel Core i7 (8th Gen or newer)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2/M3 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560X (or equivalent)
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
